completeness_tests: Validate model presence against minimum dataset.
Validate expected row counts against Odoo search_count manifests.
Validate full FY date coverage for date-scoped models.
Validate no first-N cap unless sample_mode is explicitly enabled.
Validate no duplicate snapshots in the same scanned root.
Validate company_id = 4 scope on company-scoped records.
accounting_integrity_tests: posted moves included; draft/cancelled moves separately identified
late write_date changes after FY end
pos_revenue_tests: POS sales reconcile to revenue accounts
bank_reconciliation_tests: bank statement line matched to accounting move
payment matched to invoice/bill via account_partial_reconcile
gst_tax_tests: tax base lines support tax lines
amount_tax reconciles to tax move lines
product_stock_cogs_tests: invoice/POS product lines link to products
stock valuation links to stock moves and accounting moves
audit_trail_tests: field tracking for payment state, amount, date, partner, account
attachments missing for supplier bills or imported bank records
